summary: Tested multi-provider SMS chain (Route Mobile → Africa's Talking → Twilio → WhatsApp) end-to-end. All 10 backend pytest cases pass against the public preview URL (auth, admin gating, provider shape, chain attempts, /auth/otp/start dev fallback with testCode). Frontend admin/sms screen verified on mobile viewport (390x844): admin home card at position 3 with chatbubbles-outline icon, provider list in correct priority order 1-4, only Route Mobile READY (BBKIGALI sender), summary shows '1 of 4 providers configured', SEND TEST returns full attempts string 'route_mobile:69|... | africas_talking:not_configured | twilio:not_configured | whatsapp:not_configured'. No React Native or Expo deprecation issues detected. No blockers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /admin/sms/providers correctly hides secrets (only booleans + sender IDs surface). No password / API-key leakage — validated in test.
The refresh button in /admin/sms header (top-right) has no testID — nice-to-have to add testID='sms-refresh' for future automation, but not blocking.

Route Mobile response in preview is 'route_mobile:69|<phone>' (HTTP 200 body '69' = invalid IP / unknown sender). The spec expected code 1703 — cosmetic only; chain-fallback still works because the parser treats anything non-numeric-1701 as failure and moves on.
server.py is now 2260 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/, admin/, sms/, billing/) before the file grows further. Not a regression from this iteration.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing admin phone +250798875272 (auto-promoted) reused for auth. Verify tests used a temporary non-admin phone +250788119955.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs on public URL https://radio-vod-platform.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin phone +250798875272 always returns testCode=123456. SMS_DEV_RETURN_CODE=true means /auth/otp/start returns a testCode field when SMS chain fails. Auth token is returned as 'accessToken' (not 'token') in /auth/otp/verify response. Web preview stores token under localStorage key 'bbfm.token' as a JSON-encoded string (double quotes) — must JSON.stringify() before setItem. Run pytest with '-o addopts=' to disable xdist and avoid OTP race conditions across parallel workers using the same non-admin phone.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
